verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents a versioned public REST API (v2) with OAuth 2.0 and scoped personal API tokens, per-resource endpoints such as contacts, and a reference generated from a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec. Self-serve sandboxes, a dated changelog, and an llms.txt for AI consumption round it out. The OpenAPI probe 404s only show the spec is not at those guessed paths; the spec is published on GitHub. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end, and a runnable try-it console (the examples are static curl).
